title: Concurrency Patterns Guide
description: Runnable examples: asyncio producer-consumer with bounded queue, semaphore rate limiter, circuit breaker, order pipeline composition, Go channels, Java bounded pool, and an Elixir GenServer.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables: producer-consumer asyncio con cola acotada, rate limiter con semáforo, circuit breaker, pipeline de pedidos, canales en Go, pool acotado en Java y un GenServer en Elixir.
